info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Track Deliveries API provides real-time tracking information for food delivery services. Users can monitor the progress of their food orders, ensuring they stay informed from dispatch to delivery. This endpoint benefits restaurant operators and delivery personnel by offering insights into delivery status and estimated arrival times. It is commonly used by delivery apps and service platforms to enhance customer experience by providing live updates on their orders.

get.summary: Retrieve the tracking information for deliveries.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the tracking details of their deliveries, providing real-time status updates and location information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to track delivery status based on given parameters. Ensure that all required fields are included to receive accurate tracking information.

200.description: Successful retrieval of delivery tracking information.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesTracksRequest.description: A JSON string representing the request body for the GET operation related to delivery tracking.

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the delivery tracking request.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the delivery.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the delivery.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking request.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesTracksResponse.description: Response schema for the delivery tracking operation.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the tracking entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tracking entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the entry was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the delivery tracking entry.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request and generate the response.
